hints.title: Sorted Traversal Order
hints.text: An in-order traversal of a BST visits node values in strictly ascending numerical order.

hints.title: Adjacent Element Comparisons
hints.text: The minimum difference between any two nodes must occur between adjacent elements in the sorted in-order traversal.

hints.title: Running Minimum Delta
hints.text: Maintain a pointer to the previously visited value during in-order traversal, updating the global minimum difference at each step.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: In-order traversal visiting each node once while maintaining previous node value.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of nodes takes O(N^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Call stack uses O(H) auxiliary space for recursive traversal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverage BST property that in-order traversal produces non-decreasing sequence.
